purpose: The Refund Service enables merchants to return money to customers and provides support tools for when a merchant cannot process a refund.

components.name: refund-core
components.evidence: At the heart of the solution is refund-core, the decision engine that checks a request against the original payment, applies the approval rules and orchestrates the return of the money.

components.name: Refunds Gateway
components.evidence: In front of it sits Refunds Gateway, the single entry point for merchant integrations and for the support console.

components.name: refund-db (PostgreSQL)
components.evidence: Behind it sit refund-db (PostgreSQL), the trusted record of every refund, and refund-events (Kafka), the real-time stream that keeps the ledger and the notifications in step.

components.name: refund-events (Kafka)
